notes:
User wants to optimize their Instagram content strategy, increase engagement, and grow their audience. Their follower count is now believed to be close to 1,300 (previously 1,250). They post regularly and maintain a consistent visual aesthetic, and are increasingly focused on content creation and digital marketing. Their audience is mostly in the US, UK, and Australia. They use Instagram Insights to assess content themes, formats, hashtags, timing, captions, CTAs, and engagement.

They are interested in captions with strong hooks, concise/scannable writing, storytelling, humor, questions, emojis, relevant hashtags, and clear CTAs. For a recent industry event, they liked this caption structure: “Just back from [Event Name] and still buzzing from the insights! What was your favorite takeaway from the conference? Share with me in the comments!” Suggested niche-specific hashtags were #contentcreation, #digitalmarketing, and #socialmediastrategy. They may also use event/attendee tags and a branded hashtag.

User plans to use Instagram Live more often, especially interactive Q&As. Helpful approaches include promoting it beforehand, collecting questions through DMs or a hashtag, setting a clear topic, explaining the format, encouraging comments and using question stickers, acknowledging viewers, preparing common questions, using a moderator, and following up afterward. Participation can be encouraged with shoutouts or small incentives while maintaining a friendly, nonjudgmental conversational tone.

User is exploring creator collaborations and prefers to start with micro-influencers. They plan to approach Ashley Gaida with a guest blog post about creating engaging Instagram content. Their draft outreach was:

“Hi Ashley, I've been following your content on content creation and digital marketing, and I love your insights. I think our audiences would really benefit from a guest post on my blog about creating engaging Instagram content. Would you be interested in writing a post for my audience?”

They were advised to briefly describe the blog’s focus and target audience so Ashley can assess fit. Potential future collaborations include guest posts/videos, social takeovers, expert interviews or Q&As, content swaps, shoutouts, and co-created resources.
